purpose: Verify that the actual active SpaceClaim document matches the expected identity before script control.
trigger: Use immediately before script loading/execution when document focus may have changed.

inputs.name: active_document_state
inputs.description: Observed model-document state, title/path/hash, active marker, and script-console distinction.

inputs.name: expected_document_identity
inputs.description: Expected path/hash/title or explicit unsaved-document marker.

preconditions: The active document identity can be observed independently of the script console.
Expected identity includes stable path/hash or an explicit unsaved marker.

outputs.name: match_status
outputs.description: One of matched, mismatched, unavailable, or needs_manual_review.

outputs.name: active_document_identity
outputs.description: Observed actual document identity and active-session binding.

postconditions: Return matched only when actual and expected identities agree.
Mismatch or unknown identity blocks script loading/execution.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. State verification only; it does not switch focus or repair mismatch.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Active model document does not match expected identity.
failure_modes.detection: Path, hash, title, or marker differs.

failure_modes.condition: Controller cannot distinguish the active model document.
failure_modes.detection: Only a console/window label is visible or state is transient.

recovery.action: Use ER-09 for one document-state recovery, then verify again.
Return needs_manual_review and obtain an observable identity.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Return matched only when actual and expected identities agree.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
